cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.
